title: Scalar compatibility of the two return words
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, distinct invertible prime l, finite extensions E and M of Q_l, an algebra map iota:E→M, and an integral comparison system C satisfying IntegralComparisonRealizationCoherence. For any finite-type X0 over k0 and any positive return period r+1 and scheme point z with the stated Frobenius return equality w, the specified return square commutes with scalar extension on the entire system, on the integral realization, and on its raw rationalization: SystemScalarEquation, IntegralScalarEquation and RationalScalarEquation of [def-trf-iterated-return-transport-data].

source.place: Last sentence, Frobenius transport: returned local normalization proof, Steps 2, 8, 9.

proof.text:
First use the specified integral simultaneous quotient diagrams. Write $b:T_sH_E\xrightarrow{\sim}H_MT_X$ for the scalar comparison for their common scheme map. The mixed composition/scalar equation of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], iterated along the words $zg_s^m$ and $g^mz$, gives
$$r_Mb=U_M^m(a)\delta_P T_s(r_E),\qquad s_Mb=P_M(d)a_{G_E^m}T_s(s_E).$$
The same $b$ occurs because $g^mz=zg_s^m$ and the cited node respects equality of maps and arbitrary finite iterations. These are its identities on the whole simultaneous quotient diagrams before realization and then on integral realizations. Multiply the first identity on the left by $s_Mr_M^{-1}$ and on the right by $T_s(r_E)^{-1}$ and substitute the second:
$$v_MU_M^m(a)\delta_P=s_MbT_s(r_E)^{-1}=P_M(d)a_{G_E^m}T_s(s_Er_E^{-1}).$$
This proves the first scalar identity, including its assertion before realization. Rationalization preserves equality, composition and inverses, and hence gives the required rational equation [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi].

theorem returnScalarSquares
    (hC : IntegralComparisonRealizationCoherence l E M ι C)
    (X₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [∀ x : Spec (.of D.k), Invertible (l : (Spec (.of D.k)).residueField x)]
    [∀ x : (D.geometricFiber X₀).left,
      Invertible (l : (D.geometricFiber X₀).left.residueField x)]
    (r : ℕ) (z : Spec (.of D.k) ⟶ (D.geometricFiber X₀).left)
    (w : ((End.of (frobeniusPointIso D).hom) ^ (r + 1)) ≫ z =
      z ≫ ((End.of (D.geometricFrobenius X₀).hom) ^ (r + 1))) :
    SystemScalarEquation D l E X₀ M ι r z w ∧
      IntegralScalarEquation D l E X₀ C M ι r z w ∧
      RationalScalarEquation D l E X₀ C M ι r z w
